messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — PineCap dashboard shows a sharp drop in API calls starting Thu. DAU -68% WoW. Their champion (Nikhil) left last Friday and I heard they kicked off a WaveAI pilot. Renewal in ~9w. Anyone tracking?

leo_revops: :eyes: can you attach the usage snapshot and any top failing endpoints?

maria_cs: pasted quick summary in thread — main drop is /v1/generate and /v1/embed, majority from our EU region. small CSV: date,requests
2026-03-12,4200
2026-03-13,4100
2026-03-14,1300
2026-03-15,900
2026-03-16,700

raj_engineer: I pulled logs for 03-14 03:12-03:30 UTC — spike in 500s from their integration host. sample stack trace below. working hypothesis: malformed batch headers -> runtime path error.

```
2026-03-14T03:12:14Z ERROR handler.go:142 requestID=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate status=500 err="panic: slice bounds out of range"
goroutine 1024 [running]:
main.batchProcess(0xc0000f0000, 0x3, 0x3)
\t/home/runner/serve/runtime/batch.go:88 +0x1f2
```

emma_cs: Scheduled a 30m health-check with PineCap PM + new CTO for Tue 10am PT. Agenda: reproduce integration error, show token/cost breakdown, and competitive delta vs WaveAI.

sylvia_ae: prepping a win-back pack. Can we offer a free optimization session + 30% off first month of Dedicated to buy time? If engineering fixes the 500s quickly, we pitch stability + cost savings.

leo_revops: Recommend fast mitigations: 1) rollback recent client sdk change? 2) apply hotfix for batch header parsing (if raj confirms) 3) present token-level billing and caching ops to PM. I can whip up a cost comparison chart vs WaveAI.

raj_engineer: hotpatch ready, patching prod now. will route failing requests to fallback model while we roll. creating incident for tracking.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 created and assigned to raj_engineer — priority: high.

raj_engineer: hotpatch deployed in EU, fallback routing enabled. error rate down from 12%->0.7% in the last 20m. watching.

maria_cs: awesome — looping PineCap contacts. adding notes to renewal tracker and marking as "at-risk: advocate left + competitive pilot". Will push for the optimization session in the Tue meeting.

emma_cs: if patch stabilizes and ROI slides well, propose a short Dedicated trial + caching config review. Also prepare a one-pager on rollback/fallback guarantees and our canary plan to reassure procurement.

sylvia_ae: I'll include a 90-day pilot offer + a tailored SOW for optimization. AE will request exec QBR slot on next renewal cadence.

leo_revops: I'll have a cost vs latency chart and a suggested batching/caching config by EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: thanks team — keep updates here. If error creeps back, we'll escalate to SE and product. :thumbsup:
